short_description: Hands-on 90-minute spray paint and stencil workshop taught by Studio W.I.P. artists where participants create take-home street-art canvases.
location_address: 1744 North Kimball Avenue Chicago, IL US 60647
description: Unleash your inner street artist in a high-energy, no-pressure workshop led by Studio W.I.P. artists. Over the session you’ll learn real street-art techniques—spray paint handling, stencil application, lettering and textures—while creating your own original canvas to take home. The atmosphere blends party vibes and hands-on instruction so newcomers and experienced creatives alike leave feeling inspired, confident, and proud of a finished piece.

highlights:
* Learn real street-art techniques used by muralists and graffiti artists
* Immersive, high-vibe workshop with music and creative energy
* Suitable for beginners, groups, dates, and families
* Leave with an Instagram-ready, take-home piece you’ll be proud of
* Studio culture that’s welcoming, authentic, and community minded
